---
name: Documentation or validator defect
about: Report a confusing passage, broken link, or reproducible validation defect.
title: ""
---

## Repository commit and environment
Commit SHA; Python version and operating system if relevant.

## Affected passage or command
File, link, or exact command; provide a minimal non-sensitive example.

## Expected and observed behavior
Distinguish a confusing summary, an invariant failure, and a substantive design concern.

## Proposed correction and verification
Explain the correction, relevant check, and any uncertainty. Do not change
reviewed hashes simply to suppress a failure. Exclude sensitive data and exploits.
